text:
amal: Heads-up — we're planning to tighten KMS Decrypt principal scope and flip ptls enforcement (mTLS) in EU + APAC next Wed 03:00-05:00 UTC. This may affect keystore unwrap for older rotator/service accounts. Any objections or known blockers?

sam: saw a couple unwrap errors in apac-staging yesterday after the IAM role rename. stacktrace below, nothing huge but consistent: 
```
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z keystore/unwrap error: kms:DecryptAccessDenied principal=svc-keystore-rotator@apac-staging denied key=projects/redwood/locations/apac/keys/keystore-main
```

kevin: that matches — my PR (narrow-kms-principals) removed the legacy rotator principal. I added the new service-account binding but forgot to update the rotator job identity. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/merge/8421

marie: is that the same rotator that pushes ephemeral certs to the edge? If it fails, some services fallback to TLS but without client certs, which could cause auth errors. We saw a 3% spike in 403s yesterday on /internal/auth.

ops-oncall: incident-bot: alert triggered — spike in east-west 403s (apac) 2026-03-18T14:10Z-14:20Z, correlated with keystore unwrap failures.

amal: ok — propose immediate mitigation: revert the PR narrow-kms-principals in prod (fast rollback) OR grant temporary decrypt to the legacy rotator SA until we update identities. Which is faster?

dylan: granting temporary decrypt is a single KMS policy change, quicker than rolling back infra PR. But we need audit entries for traceability and expiry. We should add an expiration tag and a ticket.

kevin: I can push a short-lived IAM binding with 'condition: request.time < timestamp("2026-03-25T00:00:00Z")' and annotate the change in the audit log. Will add a KMS change ticket and a 72-hr auto-reminder.

sam: while we're at it, can we add richer correlation IDs to the rotator logs? Right now log lines are noisy. Suggest env var ROTATOR_REQUEST_ID -> include in unwrap calls and KMS audit context.

marie: +1 on correlation ID and add a fallback metric for 'ptls-client-cert-missing' so we can alert before 5xxs surface.

keystore-bot: rotator-job: unwrap failed 12/03 14:12 UTC — DecryptAccessDenied for svc-keystore-rotator@apac-staging. job_id=rotator-2026-03-18-14 tz=UTC

amal: action items: 
- kevin: apply conditional temporary decrypt binding and post change + expiry in #eng-security (ETA 15m)
- sam: instrument rotator with correlation ID + demo in staging (ETA EOD)
- marie: add ptls-client-cert-missing metric and a canary alert (ETA EOD)
- dylan: open RFC for RBAC rollback/rollforward playbook and audit log schema (ETA tomorrow)

kevin: started IAM change, adding condition with expiry. will paste policy snippet when done.

sam: quick snippet for including correlation id in code: 
```python
req_id = os.getenv('ROTATOR_REQUEST_ID', str(uuid4()))
resp = kms_client.decrypt(name=key_name, ciphertext=cipher, request_id=req_id)
logger.info(f"unwrap success job={job_id} req_id={req_id}")
```

amal: excellent. once we have temporary binding, let's run a targeted replay in apac-staging for 30 minutes and watch the keystore unwrap rate and ptls alerts. If green, schedule full ptls enforcement window; if not, rollback plan B.

ops-oncall: incident-bot: change implemented by kevin at 2026-03-18T14:20Z — temporary KMS decrypt binding applied with expiry 2026-03-25T00:00:00Z.

marie: confirmed unwraps succeeded after binding. /internal/auth 403s dropped back to baseline. I'll keep the canary alert on and escalate if noise returns.

dylan: I'll start drafting the RBAC hardening playbook: pre-change checklist (verify service identities, test decrypt with principal, add audit log correlation, set conditional expiries), rollback steps, and a sampling plan for OC logs. Will circulate draft in #eng-security tomorrow.

amal: thanks all — keep comments in this thread for the next steps. We'll coordinate PTLS enforcement date after playbook review. :thumbsup:
